main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads 5-row boards of n columns from standard input, repeatedly scores and removes vertical runs of equal nonzero values with leftward compaction across 11 cascade iterations, prints each board's total score, and repeats until n equals 0." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: int "Returns 0 after all boards are processed and n becomes 0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read an integer from standard input into n using a %d scanf call, without checking the return value; if the read fails, n is left unchanged or uninitialized. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Enter the outer while loop, repeating as long as n != 0; at the beginning of each iteration reset point to 0. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, initialize the 5x20 board a by setting a[j][i] = 0 for every column i from 0 to 19 and every row j from 0 to 4. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, read board cells into a: for each i from 0 to n-1 and each row j from 0 to 4, read an integer from standard input into a[j][n-1-i], reversing the input column order into the last n columns of a; this is valid only when n <= 20 because a has 20 columns, and columns n through 19 remain zero from initialization. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the outer while loop, set m = 11 to initialize exactly 11 cascade iterations. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND Enter the inner while loop, repeating while m > 0; first zero the auxiliary board b by setting b[j][i] = 0 for every i from 0 to n-1 and every row j from 0 to 4; b has only 10 declared columns, so this is valid only when n <= 10. RESULT b]
            [COMMAND Within the inner while loop, for each column i from 0 to n-1, evaluate the vertical match conditions in the exact if/else-if priority order, updating point and marking matched cells in b. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Within the per-column scoring step, if a[0][i] == a[1][i] && a[1][i] == a[2][i] && a[0][i] != 0, then check the lower cells: if a[2][i] == a[3][i], then when a[3][i] == a[4][i], add a[0][i] * 5 to point and mark rows 0 through 4 by setting b[j][i] = 1 for j = 0..4, otherwise add a[0][i] * 4 and mark rows 0 through 3; if a[2][i] == a[3][i] is false, add a[0][i] * 3 and mark rows 0 through 2. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Within the per-column scoring step, if the first condition was false and a[1][i] == a[2][i] && a[2][i] == a[3][i] && a[1][i] != 0, then if a[3][i] == a[4][i], add a[1][i] * 4 to point and mark rows 1 through 4; otherwise add a[1][i] * 3 and mark rows 1 through 3. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Within the per-column scoring step, if the first two conditions were false and a[2][i] == a[3][i] && a[3][i] == a[4][i] && a[2][i] != 0, then add a[2][i] * 3 to point and mark rows 2 through 4 by setting b[j][i] = 1 for j = 2..4. RESULT point]
            [COMMAND Within the inner while loop, clear matched cells: for each column i from 0 to n-1 and each row j from 0 to 4, if b[j][i] == 1, set a[j][i] = 0 and b[j][i] = 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the inner while loop, apply leftward compaction by repeating the following sweep n times, for e = 0..n-1: for each row j from 0 to 4 and each column i from 0 to n-1, if a[j][i] == 0, shift left by copying a[j][l] = a[j][l + 1] for l = i..9; this fixed upper bound of 10 means full compaction is only guaranteed when n <= 10. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Within the inner while loop, decrement m by 1 and continue the loop while m > 0. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND After the inner while loop exits, print the value of point followed by a newline to standard output. RESULT stdout]
            [COMMAND Read the next integer from standard input into n, then continue the outer while loop if n != 0. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND When n == 0, exit the outer while loop and return 0 from the program. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
